newsitem.title: USA: CBOE files to list options on Morgan Stanley index.
newsitem.headline: CBOE files to list options on Morgan Stanley index.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange said Monday it filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to list cash-settled index options on the Morgan Stanley Multinational Index.
The CBOE said it also filed to list long-term equity anticipation securities (LEAPS) on the index.
The index, composed of 50 U.S.-listed high capitalization stocks, is capitalization weighted. As of September 27, components ranged in size from $5.50 billion to $151.1 billion.
The CBOE said NFT options would have a European-style expiration.
The components derive a large portion of earnings from foreign income and have price/earnings and price/book ratios that are generally higher than in the broad market, the CBOE said.
It said the component stocks trade on the New York Stock Exchange and the Nasdaq stock market.
The NFT was set at 200 on December 31, 1991. It ended down 0.10 at 362.07 on Monday. Its all-time high, reached September 26, was 365.29.
